title: Uniswap bulls lose $5.7M as UNI tests KEY support – What’s next?
summary: Uniswap prices plunged, breaking the critical $9 support.
content: Uniswap bulls recently suffered losses totaling $5.7 million as the UNI token faced a significant downward price movement. The cryptocurrency plunged in value, successfully breaking through the critical $9 support level. Market analysts and traders are now closely monitoring the charts to determine the next potential price direction for the asset following this important technical breakdown.
content_ta: Uniswap பulls சமீபத்தில் $5.7 மில்லியன் அளவுக்கு இழப்பை சந்தித்தனர், ஏனெனில் UNI டோக்கன் குறிப்பிடத்தக்க விலை சரிவை எதிர்கொண்டது. இந்த கிரிப்டோகரன்சியின் மதிப்பு சரிந்து, முக்கிய $9 ஆதரவு நிலையை உடைத்தது. இந்த முக்கிய தொழில்நுட்ப முறிவைத் தொடர்ந்து, சந்தை ஆய்வாளர்களும் வர்த்தகர்களும் சொத்தின் அடுத்த சாத்தியமான விலை திசையை உன்னிப்பாகக் கண்காணித்து வருகின்றனர்.

content: Cryptocurrency news website Cointelegraph is reportedly seeking a buyer following a significant decline in its web traffic. The digital media firm has been shopping itself to potential interested parties, although the specific financial valuation or asking price has not been publicly revealed.
content_ta: வெப் டிராஃபிக் சரிந்ததை அடுத்து, கிரிப்டோ செய்தி வலைத்தளமான Cointelegraph ஒரு வாங்குபவரைத் தேடி வருவதாகத் தகவல்கள் வெளியாகியுள்ளன. இந்த டிஜிட்டல் மீடியா நிறுவனம் தன்னை விற்க முயன்று வரும் நிலையில், அதற்கான விலை அல்லது தொகை குறித்த விவரங்கள் வெளியிடப்படவில்லை.

title: Vitalik Buterin backs crypto ‘bunker mode’ amid rapid AI math advances
summary: Ethereum researchers say crypto users should consider moving funds to fresh addresses, warning AI could threaten private-key security before quantum computers do.
content: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin has expressed support for a crypto bunker mode following warnings from researchers about rapid advancements in artificial intelligence. Experts caution that AI developments could pose a threat to private-key security even before quantum computers become a reality. As a precaution, users are being advised to consider transferring their funds to fresh addresses to safeguard their assets.
content_ta: விரைவான AI தொழில்நுட்ப வளர்ச்சிகள் காரணமாக கிரிப்டோ பயனர்கள் புதிய அட்ரஸ்களுக்கு பணத்தை மாற்றுவது குறித்து பரிசீலிக்க வேண்டும் என்று Ethereum ஆராய்ச்சியாளர்கள் எச்சரித்துள்ளனர். குவாண்டம் கணினிகள் வருவதற்கு முன்பே AI தொழில்நுட்பம் பிரைவேட்-கீ பாதுகாப்பிற்கு அச்சுறுத்தலாக அமையலாம் என்று அவர்கள் எச்சரிக்கின்றனர். இந்த எச்சரிப்புக்கு Vitalik Buterin தனது ஆதரவைத் தெரிவித்துள்ளார்.

title: Avalanche Tokenized Treasury Market Reaches $545 Million After Rapid Growth
summary: Tokenized US Treasury assets on Avalanche have reached roughly $545 million, according to data highlighted this week. The segment has expanded about fourfold over the past year, adding another example of institutional financial products moving onto public blockchain infrastructure.
content: Tokenized US Treasury assets on Avalanche have reached roughly $545 million following rapid growth. Data highlighted this week shows the segment has expanded about fourfold over the past year, highlighting the continued movement of institutional financial products onto public blockchain infrastructure.
content_ta: Avalanche நெட்வொர்க்கில் உள்ள Tokenized செய்யப்பட்ட US Treasury சொத்துக்களின் மதிப்பு விரைவான வளர்ச்சியைக் கடந்து சுமார் $545 மில்லியனை எட்டியுள்ளது. கடந்த ஆண்டில் இந்தத் துறை தோராயமாக நான்கு மடங்காக வளர்ச்சியடைந்துள்ளதுடன், பொது பிளாக்செயின் கட்டமைப்பில் நிறுவன நிதிப் பொருட்கள் நுழைந்து வருவதை இந்த தரவு காட்டுகிறது.

title: Tokenized Securities Firm KoreInside Targets Ethereum, Solana And Avalanche With New Web3 Partnership
summary: KoreInside and Digital Motion have formed a partnership designed to help issuers move regulated tokenized securities onto public blockchains including Ethereum, Solana, Avalanche and Base. content: KoreInside and Digital Motion have partnered to help issuers bring regulated tokenized securities onto public blockchains. The collaboration integrates securities compliance infrastructure with technical systems, enabling assets to be deployed on networks including Ethereum, Solana, Avalanche, and Base. This initiative aims to bridge traditional compliance requirements with public blockchain deployment.

title: PONS rallies 10% despite net selling: Can bullish traders hold the line?
summary: Could forced short closures supply the buying pressure that PONS’s latest trading flows lacked?
content: PONS shares surged 10% despite experiencing net selling pressure from investors. Market analysts are questioning whether bullish traders can maintain this upward momentum. The recent price rally may have been fueled by forced short closures, potentially compensating for the lack of organic buying pressure seen in the latest trading flows.
content_ta: நிகர விற்பனை அழுத்தம் இருந்தபோதிலும் PONS பங்குகள் 10% உயர்ந்தன. இந்த ஊக்கத்தை காளை சந்தை வர்த்தகர்களால் தொடர்ந்து தக்கவைக்க முடியுமா என்று சந்தை ஆய்வாளர்கள் கேள்வி எழுப்புகின்றனர். சமீபத்திய வர்த்தக ஓட்டங்களில் காணப்பட்ட வாங்கும் அழுத்தமின்மையை ஈடுகட்டும் வகையில், கட்டாய குறுகிய மூடல் நடவடிக்கை இந்த விலை உயர்வுக்கு காரணமாக இருந்திருக்கலாம்.

title: Sui hits 40M TPS record — But there’s one catch
summary: The token slipped on the same day as the record. Tough room?
content: The Sui network recently achieved a notable milestone by recording 40 million transactions per second (TPS). However, despite this impressive technical achievement and record-breaking performance, the associated token experienced a price drop on the exact same day. Market observers noted the ironic timing, as the network celebrated its high throughput while its native asset faced downward pressure.
content_ta: Sui நெட்வொர்க் சமீபத்தில் 40 மில்லியன் TPS சாதனையை எட்டியுள்ளது. இருப்பினும், இந்த குறிப்பிடத்தக்க தொழில்நுட்ப சாதனை மற்றும் வரலாற்றுச் சிறப்புமிக்க செயல்திறன் இருந்தபோதிலும், அதே நாளில் தொடர்புடைய டோக்கன் விலை சரிவை சந்தித்தது. நெட்வொர்க் தனது உயர் பரிவர்த்தனை வேகத்தைக் கொண்டாடிய வேளையில், அதன் சொந்த சொத்து வீழ்ச்சியைச் சந்தித்தது சந்தை பார்வையாளர்களால் கவனிக்கப்பட்டது.

title: ORCA rallies 12%: Can $2.50 support survive the FOMC reaction?

content: ORCA experienced a 12% price rally, bringing attention to crucial market levels as traders prepare for the upcoming FOMC reaction. Analysts are closely watching a $6.93 million liquidity cluster, which serves as a key destination for market participants. Successfully holding the $2.50 support level may determine the future price trajectory for ORCA in the near term.
content_ta: ORCA விலையில் 12% உயர்வு ஏற்பட்டுள்ளது, மேலும் வரவிருக்கும் FOMC எதிர்வினைக்காக வர்த்தகர்கள் தயாராகி வருவதால் இது சந்தை கவனத்தை ஈர்த்துள்ளது. சந்தை பங்களிப்பாளர்களுக்கு ஒரு முக்கிய இலக்காக விளங்கும் 6.93 மில்லியன் டாலர் நீர்மை திரட்சியை (liquidity cluster) ஆய்வாளர்கள் உன்னிப்பாக கவனித்து வருகின்றனர். 2.50 டாலர் ஆதரவு நிலையை வெற்றிகரமாக தக்கவைத்துக்கொள்வது ORCA-வின் எதிர்கால விலை போக்கைத் தீர்மானிக்கலாம்.

summary:

title: Almost a Third of 16–19-Year-Olds Have a Side Hustle, but Most Are Unsure Which Bank Account Suits Them Best
summary:
New analysis from the Current Account Switch Service, owned and operated by Pay.UK, reveals that nearly a third (31%) of 16-19-year-olds are already earning money from a side hustle, but six in ten (60%) of those doing so are unsure whether a personal or business account is right for them. Pay.UK is encouraging young earners to consider which account best suits their goals, circumstances, and the way they manage their money.
A survey of 2,000 young people aged 16-19 found that 23% currently have one side hustle and 8% juggle more than one. A further 28% plan to start one in the next 12 months, meaning almost six in ten (59%) already have a side hustle or intend to start one soon.
The findings come at a time when business bank account switching is on the rise, with the Service recording 8,136 small business and charity account switches between April and June, up from 7,915 in the previous quarter. However, having a side hustle doesn't automatically mean someone needs a business account. The right option will depend on an individual's circumstances, how they earn money, and how they plan to manage it.
Most side hustlers rely on their everyday account
Among the respondents currently earning money from a side hustle, more than half (56%) mainly use the same personal bank account as they do for everyday spending. A further 15% use a separate personal account, 12% use a mix of accounts, and only 9% use a business bank account. The remainder are unclear which account they use, take cash in hand, or use another type of account.
Despite most already using a personal account, confusion about which type of account they should use remains widespread. Almost six in ten current side hustlers (60%) agree they don’t know whether they are supposed to use a personal or business account, including 22% who strongly agree, with only 13% in disagreement.
This lack of clarity rises with age: two-thirds (62%) of 18-19-year-old side hustlers are unsure which account type to use, compared with 42% of 16-17-year-olds. Young men are also slightly more likely than young women to have a side hustle (35% versus 29%) and to be uncertain about the right account (66% versus 55%). Side-hustle activity is highest among part-time workers, at 39%.
Choosing an account that fits
Having a side hustle doesn’t automatically mean someone needs a business account. A young person earning occasional money from babysitting or odd jobs may have different needs from someone receiving regular customer payments and managing ongoing costs.
Before deciding whether a personal or business account is right for them, young earners should consider:
How regularly they earn income
Whether they want to separate personal and side-hustle finances
The features and services they need from an account
Any fees or eligibility requirements
Whether their existing account terms already meet their needs
In some cases, an existing personal account may be suitable. Where someone believes a different account could be a better fit, they should compare options carefully and seek independent guidance if unsure.
The Current Account Switch Service website hosts a handy online questionnaire asks a few quick questions and provides a personalised checklist of things to consider when comparing accounts.
John Dentry, Product Manager of the Current Account Switch Service at Pay.UK, said:
"It's interesting to see that so many young people with a side hustle aren't sure which type of account is right for them. Every side hustle is different, so the best option will depend on how someone earns money, how they want to manage it and what they need from their account.
For some people, their existing account may already meet their needs, while others may decide that a different account is a better fit. What's important is taking a little time to compare the options available and understand what works best for their circumstances.
Our online questionnaire provides a personalised checklist to help people think through those considerations. If another eligible personal or business current account turns out to be a better fit, the Current Account Switch Service provides a free, simple and guaranteed switch in seven working days.”

Control and governance is built into execution with Backbase’s Banking OS. Banks determine which information, knowledge and tools agents can access, which actions they can perform and where human approval is required. Any consequential request requires explicit customer confirmation. Records of context, checks, decisions and outcomes ensure auditable oversight.

title: Italy's CDP Venture Capital Invests in TrueLayer as Europe Builds Its Own Payment Rails
summary:
TrueLayer, Europe's leading Pay by Bank network, today announced a $27 million investment led by CDP Venture Capital (Cassa Depositi e Prestiti group), Italy's leading venture capital operator, alongside a consortium of existing and new investors. The news comes ahead of CEO Francesco Simoneschi's appearance on stage at Wave by Vento in Turin on Friday 9 October.
The investment marks a homecoming for a company founded by two Italians. Francesco Simoneschi and Luca Martinetti started TrueLayer in London in 2016 to build a modern payment network for Europe. Today the company is live in 22 countries and powers payments for some of Europe's best-known businesses, including Ryanair and Just Eat. Backing from CDP Venture Capital brings that journey full circle.
Building Europe's own payment rails
TrueLayer's flagship product, Pay by Bank, enables consumers to pay directly from their bank account, instantly and securely, using European open banking infrastructure rather than relying on US card networks. As policymakers and industry participants across the continent work to strengthen Europe's strategic autonomy in payments, TrueLayer's network offers a proven, homegrown alternative already operating at scale, with more than 30 million European consumers.
CDP Venture Capital's investment reflects a shared belief that Europe benefits from developing and strengthening its own economic infrastructure and payment ecosystems.
Built in Milan
With 70 people in the country, roughly a quarter of TrueLayer's workforce is based in Italy, and Milan is one of its core engineering hubs, building products used by businesses and consumers across Europe. The company expects to continue hiring there through 2027.
Francesco Simoneschi, co-founder and CEO of TrueLayer, said: "We started TrueLayer with a simple belief: Europe deserves payment infrastructure built in Europe. Having Italy back that belief means a great deal to us personally, especially to our talented team in Milan, who work hard every day to build the future of European payments.”
Mario Branciforti, Head of the Large Venture fund of CDP Venture Capital, said: "Europe needs payment infrastructure it owns and controls, and we are investing across the continent to help build it. TrueLayer is a clear example of what that looks like in practice, with a network already operating at scale in 22 countries. Our role is to back Italian talent, and the engineering team in Milan is developing the skills and the technology that will keep Italy at the centre of European payments for years to come."

title: Tangem Pay Goes Physical with New Visa Card and Up to 2% USDC Cashback
summary:

Designed for everyday use, the new cards can be used for everything from coffee and groceries to fuel, travel and ATM withdrawals, bringing Tangem Pay closer to the experience of a traditional financial card while keeping crypto at the center of the product.
The first physical release will be limited to up to 5,000 white cards. Cards are issued in the user's name and delivered to the shipping address provided when ordering. 
The launch addresses a familiar gap in crypto: while crypto-card spending more than tripled year over year to $1.04 billion in July 2026, using digital assets for everyday life can still require users to move between wallets, exchanges, bank accounts and separate payment products.
With the physical card, Tangem Pay users can pay online and in stores wherever Visa is accepted and withdraw cash from ATMs. ATM withdrawals are limited to $250 per transaction and three withdrawals per 24 hours, while spending is subject to plan-specific limits. The physical card complements the existing virtual card, giving users a payment option for everyday situations where a digital wallet alone is not enough.
“Crypto should work wherever people live their everyday lives, not only inside a wallet or an exchange,” said Andrey Ilinskiy, Head of Tangem Pay. “The physical Tangem Pay card makes that experience tangible. And with cashback paid directly in USDC, we are giving users a financial benefit they can actually use, rather than other points on balance to manage.”
Alongside the physical card launch, Tangem Pay is introducing 1% cashback for Basic users and 2% for Plus users on eligible purchases of $30 or more. Basic users can earn up to $100 in cashback per month, while Plus users can earn up to $300.
Cashback is paid directly in USDC to the user's Tangem Pay account at the end of each billing cycle, rather than as points or a separate reward token. All Tangem Pay plans have zero transaction fees on card purchases, with applicable FX fees, while Plus members also receive free delivery on their first physical card, free ACH/Wire on-ramp for eligible U.S. bank transfers, and Visa Signature benefits. Cashback eligibility varies by region and merchant category.
The expansion comes as stablecoins move deeper into mainstream payments. Visa reported an annualized stablecoin settlement volume of approximately $7 billion as of March 2026, reflecting the growing role of stablecoins in moving money through established payment infrastructure.

content: Jonathan Spalletta has been convicted for a massive fifty million dollar theft involving Uranium Finance. Authorities revealed that the hacker spent the stolen cryptocurrency on luxury items, including Pokémon cards, Magic cards, a rare Roman coin commemorating the assassination of Julius Caesar, and even moon-flown fabric from the Wright brothers.
content_ta: Uranium Finance-ல் நடந்த ஐம்பது மில்லியன் டாலர் திருட்டு வழக்கில் Jonathan Spalletta குற்றவாளி என தீர்ப்பளிக்கப்பட்டது. இந்தத் திருடப்பட்ட கிரிப்டோகரன்சியைக் கொண்டு அவர் போகிமான் கார்டுகள், மேஜிக் கார்டுகள், ஜூலியஸ் சீசர் படுகொலையைக் குறிக்கும் ரோமானிய நாணயம் மற்றும் ரைட் சகோதரர்களின் விண்வெளிப் பயணம் தொடர்பான துணி போன்ற ஆடம்பரப் பொருட்களை வாங்கியதாக அதிகாரிகள் தெரிவித்தனர்.

title: Gate Partners with Visa to Launch Crypto-linked Card Across 40+ Countries and Territories
summary: Gate has announced a collaboration with Visa to launch a crypto-linked card, further expanding the use of digital assets in everyday spending and global commerce. The product is expected to launch across 40+ markets globally, allowing users to make payments with digital assets online and in-store wherever Visa is accepted and more conveniently connect their Gate accounts with real-world spending.   When users make payments with the crypto-linked Visa card launched by Gate, the relevant crypto assets will be automatically converted into fiat currency at the point of sale, allowing digital assets held in their Gate accounts to be used for everyday shopping, dining, travel, and other expenses. Users can also apply for and manage the card through the Gate app and access related payment services within a familiar platform environment. Details regarding supported markets, eligibility requirements, supported assets, and service availability can be found on the product page.   Visa has an extensive global digital payments acceptance network spanning more than 175 million merchant locations across more than 200 countries and territories. Through this partnership, Gate is connecting its digital asset capabilities with Visa’s payments infrastructure, enabling users to use digital assets across a broader range of commercial scenarios and further expanding their application in everyday payments. More than 160 stablecoin-linked Visa card programmes are now live globally, with payment volume up nearly 200% year-over-year, demonstrating the rapid expansion of crypto card adoption.   This partnership builds on Gate’s existing global user base and multi-asset service capabilities. Founded in 2013, Gate now serves more than 61 million users, supports trading across 5,300+ crypto assets and 12,800+ stock assets, and provides access to TradFi products spanning metals, stocks, indices, forex, and commodities. The platform was among the first to implement 100% Proof of Reserves and has built a diversified product and ecosystem portfolio. Its broad user base, multi-asset product offering, and platform capabilities provide the foundation for Gate to extend the use of digital assets into everyday payment scenarios.   Gate has officially launched Gate Money, a globally integrated financial services application. Gate Money brings digital assets, fiat currencies, stocks, ETFs, gold, bank accounts, and payments together in the Gate app. Eligible users can also apply online for a global bank account held in their own name and manage fund receipts, transfers, asset conversions, and payments in one place. Gate’s crypto-linked Visa card further connects assets held in Gate accounts with global payment scenarios, extending Gate Money’s financial services into more everyday spending use cases and giving users greater flexibility in how they use their assets. Currently, users can update the Gate App to v8.39.0 to enable Gate Money.   Gate Founder and CEO, Dr. Han, said: “Digital assets are gradually becoming part of everyday financial life. This partnership with Visa connects the digital asset accounts Gate users already know with a broad range of commercial scenarios, making digital asset payments more intuitive and better aligned with everyday needs. As the service launches across more than 40 countries and territories, we aim to give users greater flexibility in how they use their assets and further expand the practical use of digital assets in global commerce.”   Nischint Sanghavi, Head of Digital Currencies, APAC, said: “Consumers want payment methods that are flexible, convenient, and widely accepted. Visa is committed to working with partners to expand payment choices and connect new forms of value to established digital payments infrastructure. Through our partnership with Gate, we look forward to enabling more users to use digital assets wherever Visa is accepted, further enriching their everyday payment experience.”   In recent years, digital assets have increasingly expanded into practical use cases such as payments, consumption, and cross-border commerce. By connecting digital asset accounts with Visa’s payments network, crypto cards offer users a more intuitive way to use digital assets and serve as an important gateway to integrating them into everyday economic activity.   Learn more: https://www.gate.com/announcements/article/102107   About Gate Gate, founded in 2013 by Dr. Han, is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency and integrated financial services platforms, spanning financial and everyday use cases including asset management, trading and payments. Serving over 61 million users globally, it supports trading across 5,300+ digital assets and 12,800+ stock assets, while providing access to a comprehensive range of TradFi assets, including metals, stocks, indices, forex, and commodities to meet users’ end-to-end needs across asset holding, trading and spending, trading and spending. As an industry benchmark, Gate was among the first platforms to implement 100% Proof of Reserves. Its ecosystem includes Gate Money, Gate Wallet, Gate Ventures, Gate for AI Agent, and a wide range of products and services.   For more information, please visit: Website | X | Telegram | LinkedIn| Instagram | YouTube Disclaimer: This content does not constitute an offer, solicitation, or recommendation. You should always seek independent professional advice before making investment decisions. Note that Gate may restrict or prohibit certain services in specific jurisdictions. Card services are not intended for, and should not be accessed by, those in any jurisdictions where such services are prohibited by law. For more information, please read the User Agreement.

The card allows users to automatically convert digital assets into fiat currency at the point of sale for everyday shopping and travel wherever Visa is accepted. This initiative coincides with the launch of Gate Money, an integrated financial services app combining digital assets, fiat, and payments.

title: Cboe Clear Europe Expands Securities Financing Transactions Clearing Service to U.S. Equities
summary:
Cboe Global Markets, Inc., a leading global markets operator and pioneer in equity and index derivatives, today announced that Cboe Clear Europe N.V., its pan-European clearing house, will expand its Securities Financing Transactions (SFT) clearing service from mid-October to include U.S. equities eligible for securities lending - another significant milestone in its strategy to expand the benefits of central clearing across the global securities lending market.
The service will initially support the clearing of SFTs for U.S. equities in the Russell 3000 Index and the top 500 U.S. listed ETFs, with plans to broaden coverage over time to Cboe's full U.S. equities trading universe of around 12,000 symbols. Settlement of U.S. securities will take place via the Depository Trust Company (DTC) in line with U.S. local best practices, with BNY acting as settlement agent. Similar to the service's approach for eligible U.S. corporate bonds and U.S. Treasuries, clearing of SFTs with U.S. equities being lent will initially be available only to non-U.S. lenders and borrowers.
Vikesh Patel, Global Head of Clearing and President, Cboe Clear Europe, said: "Expanding to offer SFTs with U.S. equities is another major step toward our vision of a global securities lending service, and underscores our commitment to delivering innovative solutions that create meaningful capital and operational efficiencies for market participants. The service's strong adoption since launch reflects the industry's growing recognition of the benefits of central clearing and our unique model. As we continue to broaden its coverage across asset classes and jurisdictions, we're helping participants optimise their securities financing activities globally, while contributing to the long-term growth, resilience and efficiency of the securities finance ecosystem."
Launched in 2025 for loans of European equities and ETFs, Cboe Clear Europe's SFT service has introduced central clearing to a market that has long operated on a bilateral basis, driving strong adoption from lenders, borrowers and agent lenders seeking the capital and operational benefits of the CCP model. Participants include many of the largest firms in the securities lending market, encompassing both UCITS and non-UCITS beneficial owners. As recently announced, the service was extended in August to include lending of fixed income instruments, such as European and U.S. government and corporate bonds, and reached a record €14 billion in outstanding loan value during September 2026.
The service provides a comprehensive solution for SFTs, covering trade matching, central clearing and post-trade lifecycle management, delivering significant capital efficiencies while streamlining settlement, reporting and client onboarding processes. Through its innovative "special clearing member" model, beneficial owner lenders, such as pension funds and UCITS, can utilise the service without posting margin or contributing to Cboe Clear Europe's default fund, helping unlock participation from all major sources of lending liquidity.
Jan Treuren, Head of Product, Cboe Clear Europe, said: "Our expansion into SFTs with U.S. equities is a direct response to client demand for a broader, globally consistent securities lending clearing solution. Working closely with market participants, we have designed the service around existing workflows, settlement practices and market conventions, making adoption as seamless as possible. The result is a solution that is designed to deliver meaningful capital, risk management and operational efficiencies while minimising disruption for our clients."

title: Companies Experience Sharp Increase in Business Interruption Losses
summary:
Companies are increasingly at risk from surging business interruption losses due to concentrated production, fragile supply chains, geopolitical tensions, inflation, and growing technology dependencies. According to a new analysis from Allianz Commercial, the average total value of a business interruption claim now exceeds €850,000. This is around 70% higher than the corresponding average property damage claim of close to €500,000, demonstrating that the financial consequences of being unable to operate can substantially exceed the cost of repairing the damage that caused the disruption. The report analyzes 7,888 business interruption insurance industry claims with a total value of approximately €6.74bn, or US$7.82bn, from January 1, 2021, to December 31, 2025. Although claims frequency has remained relatively stable, the average value of claims increased by over 30% annually during the past two years.  
“Business interruption and supply chain risk remains elevated and volatile. The operating environment is challenging with geopolitical tensions, trade fragmentation, cyber-related incidents, and growing dependency on technology such as artificial intelligence (AI). The scale of physical damage alone no longer determines the ultimate cost of a business interruption. Even a relatively contained incident can have consequences across production networks, customers and markets. Businesses therefore need to identify and better understand not only their own critical assets, but also those of the suppliers, technologies and infrastructure on which their operations depend,” says Thomas Lillelund, CEO of Allianz Commercial. 
Fire is the dominant cause of loss
Fire and explosion is the costliest cause of business interruption claims, accounting for more than 40% of the total value analyzed, equivalent to approximately €2.9bn, or US$3.3bn. Fire was responsible for nine of the 10 costliest man-made business interruption events in the dataset and was the most expensive cause of loss in markets including Germany, Singapore, the UK and the US. One case illustrates how losses can escalate beyond the original incident: a fire at a small manufacturing unit caused relatively limited physical damage but severely disrupted downstream operations, ultimately resulting in a nine-figure group-wide business interruption loss. Natural catastrophes are the second-costliest cause, representing 34% of the value of claims analyzed, and the most frequent, accounting for 26% of claims. Together, fire and explosion and natural catastrophe events generated more than 75% of total claim value. However, events that do not involve natural catastrophe activity remain the principal overall business interruption loss driver, accounting for 74% of claims and 66% of their total value. 
Recovery is taking longer and costing more 
Some natural catastrophe claims are developing over increasingly long periods. Two years after Hurricane Helene in September 2024, many associated business interruption claims remained unresolved, not due to coverage issues, but because affected companies had not yet fully recovered. Supply chain delays, labor shortages, and volatile material costs can extend both recovery and settlement.  
Concentrated production is also amplifying losses. Industries can depend on a limited number of specialist sites, suppliers or regions for critical materials and components, allowing a fire, cyber incident or extreme weather event at one location to cascade through global supply chains. The two costliest non-natural catastrophe events in the analysis involved fires at semiconductor factories.  
Cyber disruption broadens the risk landscape 
While ransomware remains the leading cyber-related cause of disruption, a growing share of loss activity is also being driven by cloud outages, software failures and incidents at third-party technology providers. More than 48,000 outages were tracked across cloud and software services in 2025 alone, highlighting businesses' rising dependence on digital supply chains. High-profile incidents, including attacks on software providers and logistics platforms, demonstrated how a single cyber event can disrupt thousands of organizations simultaneously. As companies become more reliant on cloud services, AI and third-party technology providers, cyber-related business interruption is becoming a more significant and complex source of loss.
“In today’s interconnected economy, preventing business interruption is no longer just about protecting individual sites. While companies have made progress in understanding their supply chain exposures, prevention remains the most effective form of risk management. Investments in fire protection, natural catastrophe resilience, cyber preparedness and business continuity planning can make a meaningful difference to both the duration and severity of a business interruption loss. Even relatively modest investments can significantly reduce the impact of disruption when it occurs,” explains Alberto Barani, Business Interruption Group Leader, Risk Consulting at Allianz Commercial.

title: Armalytix Further Strengthens Compliance and Regulatory Oversight with New Head of Legal and Compliance Appointment
summary:
Armalytix, the multi-award-winning intelligence firm delivering precision client information for AML, affordability and more, has appointed Arvin Razon as its first dedicated Head of Legal and Compliance, a move that underpins the company's ambition to be the trusted compliance infrastructure for the UK property sector as it scales across conveyancing, lending and estate agency, helping property professionals move transactions forward with confidence, and home movers complete their purchase with fewer delays.
The appointment comes as Armalytix deepens its regulatory footprint. As an FCA-registered Account Information Service Provider for seven years, the company has built a compliance framework that now needs to evolve in step with its growth across Open Banking, identity verification and Source of Funds products. Arvin's arrival gives Armalytix a senior, dedicated voice on regulation and risk, freeing the business to move faster for clients while deepening the trust conveyancers, lenders and brokers place in its platform.
Arvin brings more than ten years of experience building and leading legal and compliance functions across Open Banking, payments and fintech. He is a qualified solicitor in England and Wales, also qualified to practise in Australia and the Philippines, and holds an MBA from the University of Cambridge (Judge Business School), a Master of Laws from the University of Melbourne, and a Juris Doctor from the University of the Philippines. He is a Fellow of Information Privacy with the International Association of Privacy Professionals, with further certifications in artificial intelligence governance, privacy management, US and European privacy law and cybersecurity.
He joins from senior legal and compliance leadership roles at Paddle, Thought Machine, Brankas and ING Bank, having served as Data Protection Officer across all his previous roles. His experience spans FCA and equivalent regulatory frameworks, UK GDPR, AML and KYC programme design, ISO 27001 and PCI DSS compliance, and commercial contracting, working with regulators including the FCA and ICO, and their counterparts in Singapore, Indonesia and the Philippines. He has represented previous employers at industry working groups and regulatory consultations, and having extensively published on AI governance and data protection, assesses postgraduate courses on the subject at the London School of Economics.
In his new role, Arvin will take ownership of Armalytix's compliance framework, shaping its next phase as the company scales across the UK property and legal sector. His remit spans FCA compliance and horizon scanning, UK GDPR and international data transfers, AML and KYC oversight, and the company's ISO 27001 certification and DIATF digital identity certifications. He will act as Armalytix's primary point of contact with the FCA and ICO, and will represent the company at industry forums and regulatory consultations to influence the policy debate around Open Banking and digital identity as it affects conveyancers, lenders and brokers. 
Beyond regulation, he will lead Armalytix's commercial legal work, from contract review to supplier and partnership agreements, and will advise the leadership team on legal and regulatory risk as the business grows.
The appointment reflects Armalytix's broader commitment to operational excellence: as client volumes grow and regulatory scrutiny intensifies, the company is investing in the expertise needed to keep verification fast, accurate and dependable at scale, without compromising compliance standards.
Richard McCall, CEO at Armalytix, says: "Armalytix sits at the vanguard of driving real change in property data and pushing Open Banking forward into Open Finance, and our clients need to know that the foundations underneath our platform are as robust as the products themselves. Arvin's experience building compliance functions inside high-growth fintechs, combined with his regulatory relationships and his understanding of data and AI policy, means we now have that dedicated expertise in-house to help us keep raising the bar on our rigour and service excellence. Compliance has been at the core of Armalytix since day one, and this is about making sure our growth never outpaces our governance, and the legal and property professionals we work with, and the home movers relying on them, can trust us as the sector's compliance backbone."
Arvin Razon comments: "Armalytix is at an increasingly important intersection of Open Banking, identity and financial crime prevention, as the property sector moves to modernise risk verification. I'm looking forward to building on the strong compliance foundations already in place at Armalytix, and sharing our expertise and experience in shaping how Open Banking and digital identity are further developed and standardised in regulatory, policy and industry conversations across the conveyancing, lending and estate agency sectors in the years ahead."

content_ta: Michigan மாநிலத்தின் Livonia பகுதியில், 86 வயது மூதாட்டியின் கணக்கில் இருந்து சுமார் $24,000-ஐத் திருடியதாகக் கூறப்படும் பராமரிப்பாளர் ஒருவர் கைது செய்யப்பட்டுள்ளார். ஏடிஎம் மற்றும் கிரெடிட் கார்டுகள் மூலம் அனுமதியின்றி பணத்தை எடுத்ததாக அவர் மீது குற்றம் சாட்டப்பட்டுள்ளது. இது குறித்து Livonia காவல்துறையினர் விசாரணை நடத்தி வருகின்றனர்.

title: Sibos 2026: Is USD's position as prime global currency in jeopardy?
summary: Many global currency and trade experts have been wondering for a while now whether the US dollar might lose its luster as the world’s reserve or preferred cross-border payments and trade or asset management settlement currency. But a panel of bankers and foreign exchange experts gathering at Sibos 2026 in Miami all agreed the answer to that question is "not yet."
content: At the Sibos 2026 conference in Miami, a panel of bankers and foreign exchange experts discussed whether the US dollar's position as the primary global currency is in jeopardy. Despite ongoing discussions among trade experts about the future of the dollar as the world’s preferred reserve and cross-border settlement currency, the panel agreed that the US dollar's dominant status is secure for now.
content_ta: Miami நகரில் நடைபெற்ற Sibos 2026 மாநாட்டில், US டாலரின் முதன்மையான உலகளாவிய நாணயத்தின் நிலை ஆபத்தில் உள்ளதா என்பது குறித்து வங்கியாளர்கள் மற்றும் அந்நிய செலாவணி நிபுணர்கள் குழு விவாதித்தது. உலகின் விருப்பமான இருப்பு மற்றும் எல்லை கடந்த தீர்வு நாயமாக டாலரின் எதிர்காலம் குறித்து நிபுணர்கள் விவாதித்த போதிலும், US டாலரின் ஆதிக்க நிலை இப்போதைக்கு பாதுகாப்பாக இருப்பதாக குழு ஒருமனதாக ஒப்புக்கொண்டது.

title: AML vendor Armalytix appoints legal and compliance head
summary: Armalytix, the multi-award-winning intelligence firm delivering precision client information for AML, affordability and more, has appointed Arvin Razon as its first dedicated Head of Legal and Compliance, a move that underpins the company's ambition to be the trusted compliance infrastructure for the UK property sector as it scales across conveyancing, lending and estate agency, helping property professionals move transactions forward with confidence, and home movers complete their purchase with fewer delays.
content: Intelligence firm Armalytix has appointed Arvin Razon as its first dedicated Head of Legal and Compliance. The strategic hire aims to support the company's growth as a trusted compliance infrastructure for the UK property sector, helping professionals across conveyancing, lending, and estate agency streamline transactions and reduce delays for home movers.
content_ta: இன்டெலிஜென்ஸ் நிறுவனமான Armalytix, தனது முதல் சட்ட மற்றும் இணக்கத் தலைவராக Arvin Razon-ஐ நியமித்துள்ளது. இந்த மூலோபாய நியமனமானது, UK சொத்துத் துறைக்கான நம்பகமான இணக்க உள்கட்டமைப்பாக நிறுவனத்தின் வளர்ச்சியை ஆதரிப்பதை நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது, இது சொத்து வல்லுநர்கள் பரிவர்த்தனைகளை நெறிப்படுத்தவும் வீடு வாங்குபவர்களுக்கான தாமதங்களைக் குறைக்கவும் உதவுகிறது.
